'Accuracy purchased by physics' not identified; SECOM confounds physics absence with linear capacity
Excited TEP regimes and constructed SECOM target limit generalisation to passive industrial drift
Run the same SECOM pipeline with a nonlinear estimator; report accuracy and coverage
Report absolute interval width on SECOM; relative reduction may be impractical
x59 is an ex post choice among 590 columns; other targets may behave differently
Linearity-for-auditability overstated; trees/splines are also transparent
Experimental design does not support central claims; redesign required
Cross-dataset contrast cannot attribute accuracy to physics; anonymised data is not physics-free; use matched correct/perturbed/misspecified physics on one process
Delay effect not isolated; compare immediate / delayed-stored / delayed-arrival-time pairing; show timeline; limit scope if variable delays untested
Report alpha_t range and trajectory, count of infinite/degenerate intervals, full width distribution
0.897-0.903 at n=300 is within binomial noise; not evidence of uniform coverage
SECOM target not a priori; justify as VM target; confirm training-only selection
Debutanizer normalized to [0,1]; give denormalisation, equations, units, n-hexane proxy
Described blocked CV uses future data; compare forward-chaining; gap does not prove residual dependence negligible
R2=0.857 uses test labels online; report static and adaptive separately
Migration not reproducible: s(x), delta(x), GP kernel, optimisation, subset selection
10x gain sensitive to grid/threshold/8 repeats; GP intervals are not 'calibrated' in the conformal sense
Introduction lacks synthesis of prior work from which the gap follows
C1-C5 too long; separate original developments from integration and results
gamma=0.05 in protocol vs 0.001 in Figure 6; explain selection
S4.2 cites C6-C8 but only C1-C5 exist
Table 4 mixes a test metric with a CV metric
Define 'open-loop' per the cited bias-updater formulation
Number the principal equations
Writing needs significant improvement; methodological contribution unclear
S3 mixes methodology with case-study values; equations not enumerated
Method relies on existing references; split conformal needs exchangeability, unsuited to time series
Parameter selection (lambda, s) appears arbitrary
Experiments insufficient for negative-control attribution and delayed-condition effectiveness
SECOM changes process/objective/dimension/missingness/estimator at once; remove or shuffle physics on the same process
Capacity not fixed across datasets; 'same estimator' statement in S6.3 inaccurate
One-SE rule selects k=1, not k=4; re-execute selection
S3.2 describes leave-one-block-out; code uses forward TimeSeriesSplit
Transport lag and SECOM target chosen on complete data before splitting
